title: 火灾报警系统十问（国内版）

points.K2: 最基础的报警：人工启动
points.K3: 自动报警把信号送出去
points.S3: 离子感烟探测器含放射源
points.S4: 高噪声旁护听不漏报警

shots.scene: 欣欣站在墙上的手动报警按钮旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a red manual fire alarm call point on a corridor wall and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 火灾报警系统十问，开始！

shots.scene: 一排图标：报警按钮、探测器、喷头、消防接口、压力表
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a manual call point, a ceiling smoke detector, a sprinkler head, a fire hose inlet and a pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 按钮、探测器、喷头，一个个认识。

shots.scene: 老李带阿杰和小研在实验楼走廊抬头看天花板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer leads the young male student and the female graduate student down a lab corridor, pointing at the ceiling.
shots.narration: 老李带大家认识实验楼的消防设施。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着吸顶的圆盘问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at a round smoke detector on the ceiling with a puzzled look.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：天花板上的小圆盘是什么？

shots.scene: 老李笑着拿出空白答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer smiles and hands out blank quiz cards.
shots.narration: 老李说：答完这十道题就明白了。

shots.scene: 答题卡上十个空格和一个答案信封
shots.prompt_en: A blank answer card with ten empty boxes and a sealed envelope beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 每题先自己选，最后再核对。

shots.section_title: 最基础的报警：人工启动
shots.scene: 小研按下手动报警按钮的示意，警铃响
shots.prompt_en: A finger icon pressing a red manual call point, with an alarm bell icon ringing above it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：最基础的报警系统？
overlay: 最基础的报警：人工启动

shots.section_title: 最基础的报警：人工启动
shots.scene: 银行图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bank building icon is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 最基础，靠人按按钮启动，不止银行用。

shots.section_title: 最基础的报警：人工启动
shots.scene: 欣欣指着报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a manual call point on the wall.
shots.narration: 发现火情，先按它报警。

shots.section_title: 自动报警把信号送出去
shots.scene: 探测器发出信号线连向值班室
shots.prompt_en: A ceiling detector icon sends a signal along a line to a small control room icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：自动报警怎么送信号？
overlay: 自动报警把信号送出去

shots.section_title: 自动报警把信号送出去
shots.scene: 电线、光缆、无线电波三种连接图标
shots.prompt_en: Three link icons in a row: a pair of wires, a fiber optic cable and radio waves. No people.
shots.narration: 专用线路、电话线、光缆或无线。

shots.section_title: 自动报警把信号送出去
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在消防控制室看屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The security officer watches a blank control panel with indicator lights in a fire control room.
shots.narration: 国内送到消防控制室，有人值守。

shots.scene: 三个探测器图标：温度计、上升箭头、烟雾
shots.prompt_en: Three detector icons: one with a thermometer, one with a rising arrow, one with smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：自动报警靠哪些探测器？

shots.scene: 三个图标被大括号圈起
shots.prompt_en: The three detector icons are grouped by a big green bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 感温、温升太快、感烟，都是。

shots.scene: 两个感烟探测器并排，一个带原子符号，一个带光束
shots.prompt_en: Two smoke detectors side by side: one marked with an atom symbol, one with a light beam symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：感烟探测器分哪两种？

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起两根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two fingers.
shots.narration: 离子型和光电型。

shots.scene: 冒烟不起火的烟头图标，光电探测器亮灯
shots.prompt_en: A smoldering object with thick smoke and no flame; the light beam detector above it lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：光电感烟有什么特点？

shots.scene: 烟雾挡住光束的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of smoke particles scattering a light beam inside a detector chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 对冒烟不起火的阴燃更敏感。

shots.scene: 小火苗图标，离子探测器亮灯
shots.prompt_en: A small open flame icon; the detector with the atom symbol above it lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：离子感烟呢？

shots.scene: 两种探测器各配一个火型图标
shots.prompt_en: Two detectors each paired with a fire icon: the light beam one with thick smoke, the atom one with flames. No people.
shots.narration: 对明火反应更快，两种各有所长。

shots.scene: 喷头洒水压住火苗
shots.prompt_en: A ceiling sprinkler head sprays water down onto a small fire. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：自动喷水有什么价值？

shots.scene: 楼房剖面，楼上的人有时间撤离
shots.prompt_en: A building cross-section with small person icons on upper floors walking calmly toward the stairs. No people.
shots.narration: 直接洒向火点，楼上的人更有机会撤。

shots.scene: 烟雾变少的图标
shots.prompt_en: A smoke cloud icon shrinking with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 还能限制燃烧产生的烟和热。

shots.scene: 建筑外墙上的消防接口
shots.prompt_en: A fire hose inlet connection mounted on the outside wall of a building. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：消防车接口在哪？

shots.scene: 消防车接上水带
shots.prompt_en: A fire engine connects a hose to the inlet on the building wall. No people.
shots.narration: 设在建筑外，消防车从这里往里送水。

shots.scene: 小研指着接口前的空地
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the clear space in front of the inlet.
shots.narration: 接口前别堆东西、别停车。

shots.scene: 喷头打开，管道里的水流动，警铃响
shots.prompt_en: A sprinkler opens, arrows show water flowing in a pipe, and an alarm bell icon rings. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：水流报警是什么？

shots.scene: 王老师翻开国家标准手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank standards handbook.
shots.narration: 原题说装在室外，国内按国家标准设。

shots.scene: 阀门示意：上方空气、下方水，两个空白压力表
shots.prompt_en: A simple valve diagram with air above a flap and water below it, each side with a blank pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：干式阀上下两个压力表？

shots.scene: 上方表指针低，下方表指针高
shots.prompt_en: The upper gauge needle points low and the lower gauge needle points high. No people.
shots.narration: 上方气压明显低于下方水压。

shots.scene: 喷头打开，空气排出，水涌进管道
shots.prompt_en: A sprinkler opens, air rushes out of the pipe and water follows. No people.
shots.narration: 喷头一开气压降，水就冲进来。

shots.scene: 答案信封打开，十个对勾
shots.prompt_en: The envelope opens and ten green checkmarks appear on the answer card. No people.
shots.narration: 对对答案，你答对几题？

shots.scene: 实验室里警铃响，阿杰还在继续操作
shots.prompt_en: An alarm bell rings in a laboratory while the young male student keeps working at the bench.
shots.narration: 警铃响了，阿杰以为又是误报。

shots.scene: 小研拉他关掉热源，往安全出口走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student has him switch off a hot plate and leads him toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 关掉热源，立刻沿疏散通道撤离。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在楼外清点人数
shots.prompt_en: The security officer counts people at an outdoor assembly point.
shots.narration: 是不是误报，由值班人员确认。

shots.scene: 门上贴着气体灭火标志的房间
shots.prompt_en: A door with a gas fire suppression warning sign and a blank status light above it. No people.
shots.narration: 有的房间装的是气体灭火。

shots.scene: 门上灯闪烁，人员向外走
shots.prompt_en: The light above the door flashes while the female graduate student walks out and closes the door.
shots.narration: 报警后到放气前，人要马上离开。

shots.scene: 放气后的门口打叉禁止进入
shots.prompt_en: A no entry sign on the closed door after gas release. No people.
shots.narration: 放气后别进去，等专业人员处理。

shots.section_title: 离子感烟探测器含放射源
shots.scene: 拆下的离子感烟探测器上有电离辐射小标志
shots.prompt_en: A removed ionization smoke detector with a small ionizing radiation warning sign on its base. No people.
shots.narration: 离子感烟探测器里有微量放射源。
overlay: 离子感烟探测器含放射源

shots.section_title: 离子感烟探测器含放射源
shots.scene: 自己拆开的手图标打叉，老李装箱交回
shots.prompt_en: An icon of hands prying a detector open is crossed out; the facility engineer packs old detectors in a labeled box.
shots.narration: 不拆不丢，报废按规定交回处置。

shots.section_title: 高噪声旁护听不漏报警
shots.scene: 老周站在嗡嗡响的真空泵旁皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The older man frowns beside a noisy vacuum pump with sound wave lines around it.
shots.narration: 真空泵、超声仪，噪声让人疲劳。
overlay: 高噪声旁护听不漏报警

shots.section_title: 高噪声旁护听不漏报警
shots.scene: 老周戴上耳罩，墙上报警灯在闪
shots.prompt_en: The older man wears ear muffs; a flashing strobe light on the wall catches his eye.
shots.narration: 该戴护听就戴，同时留意闪灯。

shots.section_title: 高噪声旁护听不漏报警
shots.scene: 阿杰摘下耳机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes off his headphones in the lab.
shots.narration: 做实验别戴耳机听歌，以免听不到报警。

shots.section_title: 高噪声旁护听不漏报警
shots.scene: 泵被移进隔音罩
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum pump placed inside a sound-dampening enclosure on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 噪声大的设备，加罩或隔开放。

shots.scene: 一排图标：报警按钮、探测器、喷头、接口
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a manual call point, two smoke detectors, a sprinkler head and an outside hose inlet. No people.
shots.narration: 按钮人工报，探测器自动报。

shots.scene: 喷头洒水，人员沿通道撤离
shots.prompt_en: A sprinkler sprays while small figures walk calmly toward an exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 喷淋控火，给人争取撤离时间。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老李竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gives the facility engineer a thumbs up in the corridor.
shots.narration: 报警一响，先撤离再说。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the manual call point.
shots.narration: 认识消防设施，关键时刻不慌！
